Cluster PDF font sizes into heading levels and retain bounding boxes

```elixir title="Elixir"
input_value = %Xberg.ExtractInput{kind: "uri", mime_type: "application/pdf", uri: "https://example.com/pdf/embedded_images_tables.pdf"}
result = Xberg.extract_async(input_value, "{\"pdf_options\":{\"extract_metadata\":true,\"hierarchy\":{\"enabled\":true,\"include_bbox\":true,\"k_clusters\":6}}}")
IO.inspect(Enum.at(result.results, 0).pages)
```
